description: Spec 027 (SRD Annex E §E.2): the declared re-tuning grid for the classical references under realistic bearing error (phase-7 ranges), scored on seed 217's validation split at σ = 1° with the guarded initialisation (level 1). Objective as decision 29: median range error over every G5 row. Centred on the frozen -g1 settings and widened upward in r_scale (correlated error is absorbed by a larger measurement variance) and in process noise; the edge rule in scripts/research/spec027-tune.mjs extends r_scale and p0_scale by doubling if a winner sits on their upper edge.
